reaction_equations: MeZnO iPr + H2O → ZnO + CH4 + HO iPr
surface_mechanism_description: The self-limiting ALD binary reaction for the ZnO film may be separated into two half-reactions: (A) Zn-OH* + MeZnO iPr → Zn-O-ZnO iPr* + CH4 and (B) ZnO iPr* + H2O → Zn-OH* + HO iPr, where the asterisks designate the surface species.
evidence: In order to explain surface chemical reactions of the MZI-H2O ALD process, it is worthwhile to note mass spectroscopic study of the DMAI-H2O ALD reaction for Al2O3 thin film growth because MZI and DMAI are similar alkyl-metal-alkoxide complex precursors.21 It was confirmed that, in the DMAI-H2O ALD process, the methyl groups of DMAI precursor react preferably with Al-OH surface species than the isopropyl groups. Therefore, after the DMAI pulse, Al-O-AlO iPr species mainly remain on the top layer. Next, when H2O is pulsed, HO iPr is mainly desorbed with forming Al-OH species on the surface.
